Section B
Answer all the questions.
You may use the case study, your own enterprise experience and your knowledge of enterprise
where appropriate to answer the following questions.

text: The Kersley Village Arts Project needs to produce a business plan.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Bilaal and Ritesh were disappointed with the result of their first meeting.
Discuss how Bilaal and Ritesh could improve the effectiveness of their meetings.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Opportunities for enterprise arise in a number of different ways, including:
• identifying the demand for a product
• identifying the ability to meet the demand
• taking advantage of government policies
• using new technology to reach new markets.
Evaluate the importance of two of the above factors to the success of the Kersley Village Arts
Project.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Kersley Village Arts Project had the objective of helping the local community.
Discuss how the objectives of your enterprise project affected the way that the enterprise
operated. Use examples to support your answer.

parts.label: (b)

this is one of the reasons for the high level of customer retention.

and retain customers in your enterprise project.
